changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO preventive_maintenance_meter_call (schedule_id, due_value, reading_id, work_order_id, reading_value, call_status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT s.id, s.next_meter_value + (steps.step * s.meter_cycle_interval), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'PLANNED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM schedule s CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 11) AS steps(step) WHERE s.trigger_type = 'METER' AND s.disabled = false AND s.next_meter_value IS NOT NULL AND s.meter_cycle_interval IS NOT NULL AND (s.meter_end_value IS NULL OR s.next_meter_value + (steps.step * s.meter_cycle_interval) <= s.meter_end_value) AND (s.ends_on IS NULL OR s.ends_on > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (schedule_id, due_value) DO NOTHING
